gen-dafont-good-times-gf-esteban: Esteban reads refined and classic, its thin strokes barely lighter than the stems and its lowercase oversized beside the capitals. And Good Times, commanding and geometric, gives it a loud, confident headline to sit beneath.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-halant: Commanding geometry up top, towering letters below. Good Times holds the heading while Halant, with its outward-flicking terminals and faint thick-thin shift, rewards a slightly generous body size.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-hedvig-letters-: Loud, geometric swagger up top, with sturdy open curves waiting quietly beneath it. And Hedvig Letters Serif lets Good Times be the shouter while it stays authoritative and classic, tall and sturdy.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-noto-serif-hent: Refined and traditional, Noto Serif Hentaigana leaves every curve open and holds small letters nearly as tall as capitals. Beneath Good Times, a full paragraph would read gently and steadily.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-domine: Groovy's c nearly pinches shut and every stroke keeps the width of a single stylus. Domine brings the dignity, with open curves and a gentle pinch where they meet the stems.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-esteban: Groovy draws pipe-like strokes of one width, with a narrow slit where the c nearly shuts. Esteban, a serif with gentle swelling curves, looks best at a generous body size.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-headland-one: Friendly and funky, Groovy closes its letters up tight while Headland One sets its serif forms well apart. One jokes with a grin, the other keeps a straight, dignified face.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-ovo: Ovo reads tall and spacious, with thin strokes barely lighter than thick ones. Jelly Crazies wobbles playfully above it, its bowls nearly sealed shut, while Ovo leaves every curve open.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-esteban: Refined and classic, Esteban keeps thin strokes close to stem weight, while Joystix tracks its arcade letters wide. Esteban's lowercase already looks large, so a modest size is plenty.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-halant: Joystix spreads wide, bold arcade lettering across the line. Halant follows with towering lowercase and a faint thick-thin shift, so extended reading would feel quietly authoritative and traditional.
